title: Austin Housing Future: Millions in Funding
summary:
Austin Housing Future: Millions in Funding

*   Approve significant funding for housing programs, including a $41.9 million Grant Operating Budget and a $1.7 million Housing Assistance Fund Budget for Fiscal Year 2026-2027.
*   Invest in new housing development by authorizing a $48.5 million Capital Budget for Fiscal Year 2026-2027.
*   Solidify housing program management through a service agreement with the City of Austin, committing up to $90.5 million for various housing initiatives.
